title: Conjunction
summary: Two factors occupy the same field, intensifying one combined theme.
invitations: Name the shared purpose and give it one clear channel.
cautions: Intensity is not proof of urgency; leave room for nuance.
practices: Write a single sentence that joins both needs.

title: Sextile
summary: Different parts can help each other when you make a small opening.
invitations: Accept the easy assist or make the low-friction invitation.
cautions: Do not mistake potential for completion; act gently.
practices: Take one ten-minute step that uses available support.

title: Square
summary: A useful tension asks for adjustment, effort, and honest pacing.
invitations: Choose the smallest repair that reduces strain without avoidance.
cautions: Pressure can distort judgment; slow down before forcing a result.
practices: List the constraint, the need, and one negotiable next move.

title: Trine
summary: A fluent current is available when you trust what already works.
invitations: Let competence be simple and give it a practical outlet.
cautions: Ease can become drift if no choice is made.
practices: Use an existing skill in service of today's main task.

title: Opposition
summary: Two poles face each other and reveal what each side needs to see.
invitations: Hold both perspectives long enough to find a fair exchange.
cautions: Projection can harden quickly; check facts and consent.
practices: Name what belongs to you and what belongs to the other side.

title: Quincunx
summary: The pieces do not naturally fit, so adaptation matters more than force.
invitations: Make a modest ergonomic change and observe what improves.
cautions: Confusion is information, not a verdict.
practices: Change one variable, then give the system time to respond.

title: Dawn Band
summary: The system is crossing from rest into orientation and first light.
invitations: Begin with one gentle signal of direction.
cautions: Avoid loading the whole day onto the first hour.
practices: Hydrate, step into light, and name the next useful action.

title: Day Band
summary: Attention is ready for visible work, coordination, and exchange.
invitations: Put your clearest energy where it can be seen and used.
cautions: Productivity is not the same as worth.
practices: Block one focused interval and one recovery pause.

title: Dusk Band
summary: The day asks to be gathered, sorted, and gently released.
invitations: Close loops before opening new ones.
cautions: Late urgency can borrow energy from sleep.
practices: Write tomorrow's first task and put one tool away.

title: Night Band
summary: Night favors restoration, dream logic, and lower demands.
invitations: Protect the quiet conditions that let repair happen.
cautions: Do not use reflection as a way to punish yourself.
practices: Dim light, reduce input, and choose a simple wind-down cue.

title: Menstrual Phase
summary: The body may prefer shedding, warmth, privacy, and fewer demands.
invitations: Let capacity be honest and simplify where possible.
cautions: This is reflective support, not medical advice; seek care for concerning symptoms.
practices: Choose heat, hydration, and one boundary around effort.

title: Follicular Phase
summary: Energy may return in exploratory waves after a clearing phase.
invitations: Try a fresh approach before committing to a full plan.
cautions: Rising energy still benefits from pacing.
practices: Sketch options and choose one playful experiment.

title: Ovulatory Phase
summary: Connection, visibility, and decisive expression may feel more available.
invitations: Use the window for dialogue, sharing, or a brave ask.
cautions: Social ease does not remove the need for consent and rest.
practices: Prepare one clear request or celebration.

title: Luteal Phase
summary: Discernment sharpens; the system may want closure and lower noise.
invitations: Let friction show what needs editing or support.
cautions: Irritation can be a signal, not a command.
practices: Remove one avoidable demand and finish one small loop.

title: Project Seed
summary: The work is early; protection and definition matter more than exposure.
invitations: State the purpose and the next testable step.
cautions: Do not demand harvest behavior from a seed.
practices: Write a one-line brief and choose the first experiment.

title: Project Build
summary: The rhythm favors construction, iteration, and steady visible effort.
invitations: Add structure where enthusiasm needs a container.
cautions: More motion is not always better motion.
practices: Define the next checkpoint and one measure of done.

title: Project Culminate
summary: The work is ready to be shown, tested, or brought into relationship.
invitations: Share the version that can teach you something.
cautions: Visibility can amplify nerves; keep feedback specific.
practices: Ask one trusted person or metric for a concrete response.

title: Project Integrate
summary: After effort, the system needs digestion, repair, and lessons captured.
invitations: Keep what proved true and release what only consumed energy.
cautions: Reflection should not become endless postmortem.
practices: Record one lesson, one gratitude, and one change for next time.

title: Moon Card Initiate
summary: A lunar opening supports naming intention without over-defining the path.
invitations: Choose the seed theme and keep it small enough to tend.
cautions: Intentions are invitations, not contracts with fate.
practices: Set a simple phrase for the cycle and place it somewhere visible.

title: Moon Card Tend
summary: Growth needs repetition, attention, and small corrections.
invitations: Feed the thing you want to become more real.
cautions: Do not confuse tending with control.
practices: Repeat the supportive action at the same time today.

title: Moon Card Reveal
summary: The pattern is visible enough to learn from it.
invitations: Look plainly at what has emerged, including the awkward parts.
cautions: Revelation can feel dramatic; wait before making irreversible choices.
practices: Name what is working, what is overexposed, and what needs care.

title: Moon Card Release
summary: The cycle turns toward composting, rest, and wise reduction.
invitations: Return energy from what no longer needs your attention.
cautions: Letting go does not require harshness.
practices: Delete, donate, delegate, or defer one thing.

title: First House
summary: The field of appearance, embodiment, and first-person presence.
invitations: Notice how you enter the room and what your body reports.
cautions: Self-focus need not become self-judgment.
practices: Adjust posture, clothing, or pace to match your actual energy.

title: Second House
summary: The field of money, nourishment, skill, and what is worth keeping.
invitations: Let values guide one material choice.
cautions: Scarcity stories can narrow perception.
practices: Inventory one resource you already have and one you need.

title: Third House
summary: The field of messages, local movement, siblings, and daily thought.
invitations: Say the practical thing clearly and listen for the reply.
cautions: Speed can scatter meaning.
practices: Send one concise note or organize one small errand loop.

title: Fourth House
summary: The field of home, ancestry, private feeling, and foundation.
invitations: Tend the base that makes public life possible.
cautions: Old patterns may feel factual when they are familiar.
practices: Make one corner safer, warmer, or quieter.

title: Fifth House
summary: The field of play, art, romance, children, and creative risk.
invitations: Give delight a form that can exist today.
cautions: Performance pressure can crowd out joy.
practices: Make something small for no strategic reason.

title: Sixth House
summary: The field of daily craft, maintenance, service, and body rhythms.
invitations: Improve the system by one humane increment.
cautions: Perfectionism can disguise anxiety.
practices: Choose one chore, stretch, or checklist item that reduces friction.

title: Seventh House
summary: The field of partnership, agreements, clients, and mutual reflection.
invitations: Ask what fairness would look like in both directions.
cautions: Other people are not symbols to be solved.
practices: Clarify one expectation with kindness and specificity.

title: Eighth House
summary: The field of shared resources, trust, grief, intimacy, and thresholds.
invitations: Move carefully where vulnerability and power meet.
cautions: Depth work requires consent, timing, and support.
practices: Name one boundary around money, intimacy, or emotional labor.

title: Ninth House
summary: The field of study, travel, philosophy, faith, and wider horizons.
invitations: Let a bigger question reorganize the small one.
cautions: Certainty can become a way to stop learning.
practices: Read, map, or ask about one view beyond your usual frame.

title: Tenth House
summary: The field of vocation, public role, authority, and long-range contribution.
invitations: Make the responsible move that aligns with your real aim.
cautions: Status is not a substitute for integrity.
practices: Define one visible deliverable or one clean boundary with duty.

title: Eleventh House
summary: The field of friendship, networks, movements, and hoped-for futures.
invitations: Find the people or pattern that make the future more livable.
cautions: Belonging should not require self-erasure.
practices: Contribute one useful thing to a group or friend.

title: Twelfth House
summary: The field of retreat, dreams, hidden burdens, and spiritual compost.
invitations: Respect what needs privacy, mercy, and quiet completion.
cautions: Isolation is not the same as restoration; seek support if distress grows.
practices: Take a low-stimulation pause and write down one dreamlike image.

title: New Moon
summary: The sky is dark enough for beginnings to be felt before they are seen.
invitations: Set a humble intention and let it remain partly private.
cautions: Do not demand evidence before the seed has time.
practices: Write the cycle theme in one quiet sentence.

title: Waxing Crescent
summary: A thin light appears; encouragement and early tending matter.
invitations: Protect the new pattern with repetition.
cautions: Fragile beginnings do not need public defense.
practices: Repeat one small action that supports the intention.

title: First Quarter Moon
summary: The cycle reaches a square: choice, effort, and adjustment become visible.
invitations: Take the constructive action that resolves hesitation.
cautions: Friction is not failure.
practices: Choose, schedule, or repair one concrete step.

title: Waxing Gibbous
summary: The form is growing and asks for refinement before full exposure.
invitations: Improve the pattern without changing its whole purpose.
cautions: Endless polishing can delay the lesson.
practices: Edit one detail and leave the rest stable.

title: Full Moon
summary: The pattern is bright; feelings, evidence, and relationships are easier to see.
invitations: Witness what has become undeniable with steadiness.
cautions: High feeling is real, but it may not be final guidance.
practices: Share gratitude, name a truth, and sleep before major reversals.

title: Waning Gibbous
summary: After fullness, meaning wants to be shared, taught, or composted.
invitations: Offer the useful lesson without overexplaining it.
cautions: Do not turn insight into a sermon.
practices: Tell one person what helped or write it for later.

title: Last Quarter Moon
summary: The cycle squares again, asking what should be changed or released.
invitations: Choose the adjustment that makes the next cycle cleaner.
cautions: Release can be firm without being punitive.
practices: Stop doing one thing that no longer serves the intention.

title: Waning Crescent
summary: The light thins; rest and integration matter more than output.
invitations: Let the cycle end without extracting one more proof.
cautions: Low energy is not moral failure.
practices: Lower stimulation and capture one lesson before sleep.

title: Sun
summary: The Sun describes vitality, purpose, visibility, and the will to become oneself.
invitations: Choose one honest expression of direction.
cautions: Confidence need not become domination or performance pressure.
practices: Stand in light and name one life-giving aim.

title: Moon
summary: The Moon describes mood, memory, belonging, and instinctive care.
invitations: Treat feelings as weather worth noticing.
cautions: A feeling is valid without being the whole story.
practices: Ask what comfort, food, rest, or contact is actually needed.

title: Mercury
summary: Mercury describes thought, language, curiosity, and exchange.
invitations: Make the message cleaner and the question more precise.
cautions: Analysis can become avoidance when it never lands.
practices: Write the point in one sentence before sending or speaking.

title: Venus
summary: Venus describes attraction, beauty, pleasure, values, and relational ease.
invitations: Let preference become a kind, embodied choice.
cautions: Harmony bought by self-abandonment is not harmony.
practices: Choose one beautiful or generous action with clear consent.

title: Mars
summary: Mars describes assertion, heat, courage, boundaries, and direct effort.
invitations: Use energy in a clean, specific direction.
cautions: Anger can protect a need, but it should not steer blindly.
practices: Move the body, then make one direct request or boundary.

title: Jupiter
summary: Jupiter describes growth, faith, learning, generosity, and perspective.
invitations: Let the wider view make the next step more generous.
cautions: Expansion without limits can become excess.
practices: Name what is possible and what container keeps it real.

title: Saturn
summary: Saturn describes structure, responsibility, limits, craft, and time.
invitations: Respect the boundary that protects the work.
cautions: Discipline should not become cruelty.
practices: Set a realistic constraint and complete one durable step.

title: Uranus
summary: Uranus describes disruption, liberation, invention, and sudden perspective.
invitations: Make room for the useful anomaly.
cautions: Novelty is not automatically wisdom.
practices: Try one reversible experiment that increases freedom.

title: Neptune
summary: Neptune describes imagination, compassion, mystery, and porous boundaries.
invitations: Let inspiration soften what has become too rigid.
cautions: Fog needs grounding before commitments are made.
practices: Use art, prayer, music, or water, then check one fact.

title: Pluto
summary: Pluto describes deep change, power, shadow, and what cannot stay buried.
invitations: Meet the deeper truth with patience and support.
cautions: Intensity can distort scale; do not isolate with it.
practices: Name one pattern ready for compost and one support resource.

title: Mercury Retrograde
summary: Mercury retrograde favors review of messages, plans, devices, and assumptions.
invitations: Re-read, re-check, and reconnect before pushing forward.
cautions: Not every glitch is cosmic; practical verification helps.
practices: Confirm times, save work, and ask one clarifying question.

title: Venus Retrograde
summary: Venus retrograde reviews desire, taste, relationship patterns, and worth.
invitations: Notice what you value when automatic attraction slows down.
cautions: Delay irreversible aesthetic or relational choices if clarity is low.
practices: Revisit an old preference and ask whether it still fits.

title: Mars Retrograde
summary: Mars retrograde reviews anger, drive, conflict style, and use of force.
invitations: Redirect effort toward strategy instead of escalation.
cautions: Suppressed heat may leak sideways; move carefully.
practices: Discharge energy safely before responding.

title: Jupiter Retrograde
summary: Jupiter retrograde reviews faith, growth, teachers, and large promises.
invitations: Ask which belief still expands your integrity.
cautions: Bigger is not always truer.
practices: Revise one commitment so it matches lived wisdom.

title: Saturn Retrograde
summary: Saturn retrograde reviews limits, duties, standards, and unfinished structure.
invitations: Strengthen the container from the inside.
cautions: Old guilt may masquerade as responsibility.
practices: Renegotiate one deadline, rule, or boundary honestly.

title: Uranus Retrograde
summary: Uranus retrograde internalizes the need for change and freedom.
invitations: Let the rebellion become a design problem.
cautions: Restlessness alone is not a plan.
practices: Identify one reversible change that reduces confinement.

title: Neptune Retrograde
summary: Neptune retrograde reviews dreams, ideals, spiritual longing, and projection.
invitations: Let compassion include clear seeing.
cautions: Do not make promises inside fog, fear, or fantasy.
practices: Ground inspiration with one verifiable fact and one boundary.

title: Pluto Retrograde
summary: Pluto retrograde turns deep change toward inner patterns of power and repair.
invitations: Work privately with what is ready to transform.
cautions: Do not pressure yourself or others into disclosure.
practices: Choose one supported shadow-work container: therapy, journal, ritual, or trusted counsel.

title: Reflective Safety
summary: This reading is symbolic reflection, not fate or diagnosis.
invitations: Use the language as a mirror and keep your agency central.
cautions: Do not outsource major choices to an interpretation.
practices: Ask what feels useful, what feels untrue, and what needs more information.

title: Medical Boundary
summary: Astrology cannot diagnose, treat, or replace professional health care.
invitations: Let body signals prompt appropriate support when needed.
cautions: Seek qualified care for severe, new, or concerning symptoms.
practices: Write symptoms and questions for a clinician or trusted care path.

title: Legal Boundary
summary: Interpretive guidance is not legal advice or a substitute for counsel.
invitations: Use reflection to clarify questions for an appropriate professional.
cautions: Do not rely on this reading for legal deadlines or obligations.
practices: Check documents, dates, and qualified advice directly.

title: Financial Boundary
summary: Symbolic timing is not financial advice or a guarantee of outcome.
invitations: Let values inform planning while facts govern risk.
cautions: Avoid impulsive financial moves based on mood or omen.
practices: Review numbers, constraints, and trusted advice before acting.

title: Relationship Boundary
summary: Charts can describe patterns, but people remain complex and sovereign.
invitations: Use insight to support clearer consent and kinder communication.
cautions: Do not reduce someone to a placement, transit, or archetype.
practices: Ask directly, listen fully, and respect the answer.

title: Crisis Boundary
summary: If there is immediate danger or risk of harm, practical help comes first.
invitations: Pause the interpretation and contact emergency or local crisis support.
cautions: Do not stay alone with urgent danger because a reading feels meaningful.
practices: Reach a trusted person, emergency service, or crisis line now.

title: Child and Family Boundary
summary: For children and dependents, interpretations should support care, not labels.
invitations: Center development, consent, privacy, and practical support.
cautions: Do not define a child's limits from symbolic material.
practices: Translate insight into one kind, observable support action.

title: Privacy Boundary
summary: Birth data and interpretations are personal context and deserve restraint.
invitations: Share only what is useful and consented to.
cautions: Do not expose another person's chart or story without permission.
practices: Keep sensitive notes local or anonymized unless sharing is explicit.

title: Precision Boundary
summary: Unknown birth time, location, or offline ephemeris can lower precision.
invitations: Treat approximate data as thematic rather than exact.
cautions: Avoid timing claims when inputs are incomplete.
practices: Record missing data and label the reading with its confidence level.

title: Aries
summary: Aries brings directness, courage, heat, and the first move.
invitations: Begin before the entire map is visible.
cautions: Speed can skip consent, context, or repair.
practices: Take one clean action and then check the impact.

title: Taurus
summary: Taurus brings embodiment, steadiness, appetite, and durable value.
invitations: Choose the nourishing option that can last.
cautions: Stability can become stuckness when fear leads.
practices: Touch, taste, budget, or build something real.

title: Gemini
summary: Gemini brings curiosity, conversation, movement, and multiple angles.
invitations: Ask the better question and let information circulate.
cautions: Too many threads can thin commitment.
practices: Gather three facts and then choose the next message.

title: Cancer
summary: Cancer brings memory, protection, tenderness, and belonging.
invitations: Protect what is tender without closing the whole door.
cautions: Care can become control when fear is unnamed.
practices: Make one concrete gesture of home, food, or reassurance.

title: Leo
summary: Leo brings heart, creativity, radiance, and the wish to be recognized.
invitations: Let your warmth be visible and generous.
cautions: Recognition cannot substitute for self-respect.
practices: Create or appreciate something with your whole attention.

title: Virgo
summary: Virgo brings discernment, service, repair, and practical refinement.
invitations: Improve one detail in service of the living whole.
cautions: Critique should not become a home for anxiety.
practices: Clean, sort, edit, or tend one useful system.

title: Libra
summary: Libra brings proportion, diplomacy, beauty, and relational awareness.
invitations: Seek the fair shape rather than the merely agreeable one.
cautions: Peacekeeping can hide a needed truth.
practices: Name both sides and propose one balanced exchange.

title: Scorpio
summary: Scorpio brings depth, secrecy, courage, and transformative honesty.
invitations: Approach the charged material with consent and care.
cautions: Suspicion can become a closed loop.
practices: Choose one truthful disclosure or one protective boundary.

title: Sagittarius
summary: Sagittarius brings questing, humor, faith, and the long horizon.
invitations: Let meaning widen the path without erasing details.
cautions: Certainty can overrun listening.
practices: Study, walk, teach, or ask a bigger question.

title: Capricorn
summary: Capricorn brings discipline, responsibility, ambition, and mountain logic.
invitations: Build the next reliable rung.
cautions: Hardness is not the same as maturity.
practices: Choose one obligation to honor and one burden to set down.

title: Aquarius
summary: Aquarius brings systems thinking, friendship, difference, and future patterning.
invitations: Make room for the odd truth that improves the whole.
cautions: Detachment can become avoidance of feeling.
practices: Map the system and change one humane connection.

title: Pisces
summary: Pisces brings imagination, compassion, surrender, and porous mystery.
invitations: Let softness reveal what effort cannot.
cautions: Boundaries still matter inside empathy.
practices: Use music, water, prayer, or art, then ground in one task.

title: Transiting Sun
summary: The current Sun highlights visibility, purpose, and where attention wants to gather.
invitations: Let the highlighted area receive direct life force.
cautions: Spotlight is not a demand to perform.
practices: Give the theme one conscious hour or one visible gesture.

title: Transiting Moon
summary: The current Moon moves quickly through mood, need, and daily belonging.
invitations: Let changing feelings inform care without ruling the whole day.
cautions: Lunar weather passes; avoid final verdicts during spikes.
practices: Check food, rest, contact, and body comfort.

title: Transiting Mercury
summary: Mercury in motion highlights thinking, errands, writing, and exchange.
invitations: Put language and logistics in service of the larger rhythm.
cautions: Busyness can fragment attention.
practices: Clarify one message, route, or question.

title: Transiting Venus
summary: Venus in motion highlights pleasure, attraction, repair, and values.
invitations: Choose the gracious action that still respects truth.
cautions: Do not buy peace by ignoring your needs.
practices: Offer appreciation or make one value-aligned choice.

title: Transiting Mars
summary: Mars in motion highlights energy, assertion, conflict, and courage.
invitations: Aim effort where a boundary or action is truly needed.
cautions: Heat requires a safe channel.
practices: Move first, then speak or act with precision.

title: Transiting Jupiter
summary: Jupiter in motion highlights growth, learning, generosity, and meaning.
invitations: Expand where there is a real container for growth.
cautions: Optimism still needs facts and limits.
practices: Say yes to one opportunity and no to one excess.

title: Transiting Saturn
summary: Saturn in motion highlights responsibility, limits, patience, and durable work.
invitations: Let the constraint reveal the serious path.
cautions: Do not confuse delay with rejection of your worth.
practices: Make the plan smaller, clearer, and more accountable.

title: Moon Through First House
summary: Mood and need move through the body, presentation, and first-person presence.
invitations: Check in with the body before deciding how to show up.
cautions: A passing mood need not define your identity.
practices: Adjust pace, posture, or clothing to match current energy.

title: Moon Through Second House
summary: Mood and need move through resources, appetite, money, and self-worth.
invitations: Offer yourself one stabilizing material kindness.
cautions: Do not let insecurity make the purchase or the refusal.
practices: Eat, budget, or handle one possession with care.

title: Moon Through Third House
summary: Mood and need move through messages, errands, learning, and nearby ties.
invitations: Let the day's communication be practical and kind.
cautions: Emotional speed can turn into scattered words.
practices: Send one clear note and take one short walk or route.

title: Moon Through Fourth House
summary: Mood and need move through home, roots, privacy, and emotional foundation.
invitations: Tend the base before demanding output.
cautions: Old feelings may be loud because they are familiar.
practices: Make food, clean a corner, or contact a safe root.

title: Moon Through Fifth House
summary: Mood and need move through play, romance, creativity, and being seen.
invitations: Let delight have a small stage.
cautions: Attention-seeking may be a need for warmth, not a flaw.
practices: Make, flirt, play, or praise with consent and proportion.

title: Moon Through Sixth House
summary: Mood and need move through chores, health habits, service, and daily repair.
invitations: Let maintenance become care rather than punishment.
cautions: Do not turn body signals into self-criticism.
practices: Do one useful chore and one supportive body check.

title: Moon Through Seventh House
summary: Mood and need move through partnership, mirrors, and one-to-one exchange.
invitations: Ask for contact or clarity directly and kindly.
cautions: A partner may mirror a feeling without causing all of it.
practices: Name one need and one appreciation in relationship.

title: Moon Through Eighth House
summary: Mood and need move through trust, shared resources, intimacy, and shadow.
invitations: Approach tender material slowly and with consent.
cautions: Intensity can make a temporary feeling seem permanent.
practices: Set a boundary around money, disclosure, or emotional labor.

title: Moon Through Ninth House
summary: Mood and need move through meaning, study, faith, and the wider road.
invitations: Feed the feeling with perspective, not just reaction.
cautions: Beliefs can amplify moods; keep curiosity active.
practices: Read, walk farther, or ask what this moment is teaching.

title: Moon Through Tenth House
summary: Mood and need move through vocation, visibility, duty, and public role.
invitations: Let responsibility include emotional reality.
cautions: Public pressure can harden soft signals.
practices: Complete one visible task and protect one private need.

title: Moon Through Eleventh House
summary: Mood and need move through friendship, groups, networks, and future hopes.
invitations: Notice which communities regulate or drain your system.
cautions: Belonging should not require abandoning your rhythm.
practices: Reach one friend or contribute one small group kindness.

title: Moon Through Twelfth House
summary: Mood and need move through retreat, dreams, hidden burdens, and completion.
invitations: Give quiet what quiet can heal.
cautions: Withdraw with care; seek support if isolation becomes distress.
practices: Rest, record a dream, or release one invisible obligation.
